subject: delta(client): WF add the read-only passiveOnly composition to both purchase factories
note: passiveOnly: true on createProtocolPurchases and createPurchaseService builds the object from the ten passive readers and the non-function members only; every active name is absent. The value is exactly true or absent, read after admission, the Node floor and stop_seam_invalid and before the factory runs; any other value throws TypeError(passive_only_invalid). The service's readers stay on the diagnostic projection after the hold lifts and never read the stop. The composition test helper takes passiveOnly and a native world as options.
